_about: Public-domain George Gillanders Findlay (1849-1919), Wesleyan Methodist tutor at Headingley College, Leeds, for the Word Hoard: his Expositor's Bible volumes on Galatians and Ephesians, his Cambridge Bible and Cambridge Greek Testament commentaries on Thessalonians, The Books of the Prophets in their Historical Succession (3 vols.), The Church of Christ as set forth in the New Testament, Christian Doctrine and Morals, The Epistles of Paul the Apostle, Wesley's World Parish (1913), and, with W. W. Holdsworth, The History of the Wesleyan Methodist Missionary Society (5 vols., 1921). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 70 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
